ai.seo_question: What is the context of Imam Ali's letters to his governors in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: This heading introduces a section of Imam Ali’s (AS) administrative correspondence, reflecting the practical application of his governance during the Caliphate in Kufa. It serves as a prelude to detailed instructions on justice, fiscal responsibility, and moral conduct, highlighting the Shi'a emphasis on the Imam's role as both a spiritual and political leader.
